creative_scope: themes grounded in supplied summaries and topics
brief professional reflection, never invented personal experience
constraints.eligibility: Fixed by Python; no additions, omissions, swaps or future-week padding.
constraints.factual_prose_rule: Do not repeat or add dates, clock times, timezone tokens, prices, numeric claims or URLs outside the required heading/fact blocks.
constraints.original_urls: Use registration_url exactly; no shortened URLs, rewritten paths or extra links.
constraints.pricing: Use price_label only when present in a required fact block; otherwise omit price claims.
constraints.publication: Human final approval and manual posting only; validation is not publication approval.
constraints.required_fact_blocks: Copy each block exactly once, in order, with blank lines separating it from other prose.
constraints.unsupported_claims: No new speakers, guarantees, personal anecdotes, statistics, scarcity, endorsements or outcomes; semantic accuracy still requires human review.
